stem: Colonel Mustard and Professor Plum are suspects in which board game, first sold in 1949?
explanation: Anthony Pratt, an English musician, dreamt it up during the Second World War. It is sold as Clue in North America, where players also hunt for the murderer, the weapon and the room.

claims.text: Colonel Mustard and Professor Plum are among the original suspects in the board game Cluedo, sold as Clue in North America.
Monopoly, Scotland Yard and Risk do not have Colonel Mustard or Professor Plum as characters.
Cluedo was devised by Anthony Pratt, an English musician, during the Second World War.
In Cluedo players work out who committed the murder, with which weapon and in which room.
